name: Dried Longan Leaf
description:
Naturally dried longan leaves for vivarium and terrarium forest-floor litter. Scatter over substrate to create a realistic woodland surface, provide hiding cover for cleanup-crew invertebrates, and add gentle tannins that support a naturalistic bioactive environment.

Product Features:
• 100% natural dried longan (Dimocarpus longan) leaves
• Soft, thin leaf litter ideal for bioactive and planted setups
• Helps create a layered forest-floor look with moss and hardscape
• Suitable for vivariums, terrariums, and invertebrate enclosures
• Natural color and shape variation from leaf to leaf

Ideal For:
Bioactive forest floors, leaf-litter layers, isopod and springtail enrichment, and naturalistic planted displays.

Note: Natural product — leaf size and tone may vary. Replace as leaves break down. Spot-clean if mould appears in high-humidity setups.
